notes.title: Patch 2.1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Update to Version 2.1.1 :

・Added V-sync and target frame rate settings to Options
・Edited text used in online matches for own team
・Fixed bug causing meat to "float" till the game is restarted when the game is quit under certain conditions
・Patch added to decrease memory usage

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Patch 2.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
Update to Version 2.1.0 :

・Daily and monthly rankings have been added
・Fixed the bug preventing time attack achievements to be unlocked

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Patch 2.0.2 - Controller support
notes.notes:
Updated to Ver 2.0.2.

- Supported controllers.

- A scoreboard is implemented where you can check various rankings.
You can check not only your own ranking but also the top ranking.

- Friend matches are now started by pressing a button.

- Other minor bug fixes have been made.


Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Update to add "Online Competitive Mode" is scheduled for 2023.07.07!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "Yakiniku Simulator".
We are planning to implement a major update on 2023.07.07 at 12:00 (JPT) to add "Online Battle Mode".
We are planning to implement a major update to add an "Online Battle Mode" on 2023.07.07 at 12:00 (JPT).

In the "Online Competitive Mode", 1 to 4 players will be able to grill meat simultaneously and compete for scores. The score fluctuates depending on the degree of grilling, so you need to eat at the best timing.
Determine the right level of grilling and become a Yakiniku Master!

Cross-play with another Yakiniku Simulator platform, which will be released soon, will also be supported.
Please wait for further details.

In addition, with this major update,
The existing ranking will be reset and a new season will be added to the ranking.
Please be aware of this in advance.

notes.title: Harami Master quick fix – patch 1.5.3
notes.notes:
The last piece of the meat in Harami Master challenge has a zero score bug.  We now fixed that bug and remove the maximum piece from 12 to 11 to compensate game’s balance and maintain all current scores in the leaderboard.

Sorry for your inconvenient.

notes.title: Patch 1.5.2 – Added more graphics settings
notes.notes:
You can now turn off some graphics settings to improve game performance.

For players who encountered rainbow graphic bug. Your graphics card may not compatible with the game’s graphics features. We recommend that you turn off those graphics features from the main menu. 
Sorry for your inconvenience.

notes.title: New "Combo Rush" and "Harami Master" challenges - Patch 1.5
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42416006/4f62214d1b9bfba869300414e867f2845c2569d0.png[/img]

2 new challenges added with new leaderboard and trophy!

Combo Rush - Focus on combo chaining in limited time. Every meats will give you equal score in this mode (with "Perfect" bonus, of course!). But the more you do combo, the more score multiplier you get.

Harami Master - Like stated in it's name. This mode is for the grill master who dare to challenge the Harami. You only have limited 12 meats, get 50,000 score on each perfect one. They is no time limit but the bonus score will decrease in every millisecond. Make it count!

notes.title: New Challenge Update! – Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42416006/e709bfff8cb39eba4c8cf1646b19bfa36213b749.png[/img]

New Time Attack challenge arrived! Let’s hit the target score as fast as possible! The mixed dish will push your brain to the limit while the timer will keep your hand busy!

Full patch notes:
-	Add new “Time Attack” mode with mixed dish and best time leaderboard
-	Add new trophies
-	Add “heat changer” to Free Mode
-	Add beer to Free Mode (hold B on keyboard to drink)
-	Restructure main menu and rename original challenge to “Score Challenge”

Happy grilling :D

notes.title: 4 Days left for Yakiniku Simulation release date!!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42416006/8aebbc56bbc8f0b4b92202909bc03691858aabf3.jpg[/img]

GAME FEATURES

This game is so sample you can play with only 1 mode but can apply to several types of play.

1. Plain play
Nothing to do so much.. just play for fun or chat with friends.

2. Play with rice
If you hungry, you can enjoy your meal with only rice bowls. (You can add more sauce or salt for a good taste.)

3. Play with beer
Enjoy the yakiniku atmosphere with cold beer. It'll make you relax.

4. Play with salad.
Do you want to diet? Don't worry, this game will make your salad's taste better!!! Try it!!!

5. ETC
You can enjoy our game in a lot of ways. Please share with us for your play!
